title: Build a RAG assistant for Business Basics
summary: Assemble a PDF-based RAG pipeline that answers business basics questions from the provided business knowledge document.
objectives: Load the business PDF into the pipeline
Chunk the document using Recursive Text Splitting
Embed and store chunks in FAISS for dense retrieval
Rerank retrieved chunks and generate a structured answer
hint: The correct business RAG flow is: load PDF, split recursively, embed chunks, store in FAISS, retrieve densely, rerank, prompt the LLM.
